# Pembagian Training dan Testing Data
```{r}
ts_sunspot<-ts_tahunan
n_total <- length(ts_sunspot)
n_test <- 20
n_train <- n_total - n_test

train_data <- window(ts_sunspot, end = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train])
test_data <- window(ts_sunspot, start = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train + 1])
```
```{r}
plot(train_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Training")
```
```{r}
plot(test_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Testing")
```

```{r}
min(train_data)
```


# Uji Stasioneritas
## Uji Fligner-Killeen
```{r}
data$Periode <- cut(data$Tahun, 
                         breaks = c(1925, 1950, 1975, 2000, 2025), 
                         labels = c("1926-1950", "1951-1975", "1976-2000", "2001-2025"))

fligner.test(Sunspot ~ Periode, data = data)
```
## Uji ADF
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(train_data)
```
# Penanganan Ragam Tidak Stasioner
```{r}
train_log <- log(train_data)
test_log <- log(test_data)

plot.ts(train_log, type="l", col="black", main="Plot Data Log(Sunspot)")
```
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(train_log)
```
```{r}
df_log <- data.frame(
  Tahun = as.numeric(time(train_log)),
  Sunspot_Log = as.numeric(train_log)
)

df_log$Periode <- cut(df_log$Tahun, 
                      breaks = 4, 
                      labels = c("Periode 1", "Periode 2", "Periode 3", "Periode 4"))

fligner.test(Sunspot_Log ~ Periode, data = df_log)
```

# Non-Seasonal
## ACF
```{r}
acf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```

## PACF
```{r}
pacf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```
Tanpa differencing karena stasioner dalam rataan (d=0). PACF cut off, indikasi AR(2) (p=2). ACF tails off, indikasi MA(0) (q=0). 
# Seasonal 
## Lag 11
### Differencing
```{r}
D1 <- diff(train_log, lag = 11) 
plot.ts(D1, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
Indikasi D=1, s=11.
### ACF setelah differencing musiman
```{r}
acf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
ACF cut off setelah lag musiman, indikasi Seasonal MA (Q=1 atau Q=0). Indikasi q=1.
### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
PACF tails off di lag musiman dan kelipatannya, indikasi Seasonal AR (P=1). Indikasi p=1 atau p=2.

## Lag 5
### Differencing
```{r}
D2 <- diff(train_log, lag = 5) 
plot.ts(D2, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
### ACF setelah differencing
```{r}
acf(D2, lag.max = 55, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 5")
```
Hasil differencing berkali2 tetap membuat ACF di lag 5 dan kelipatannya melewati garis putus.

### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D2, lag.max = 55, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 5")
```
Indikasi P=1.

# Model Fourier
```{r}
buat_fourier <- function(waktu, periode = 11, K = 2) {
  hasil <- matrix(nrow = length(waktu), ncol = 2 * K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    hasil[, 2*k-1] <- sin(2 * pi * k * waktu / periode)
    hasil[, 2*k]   <- cos(2 * pi * k * waktu / periode)
  }
  colnames(hasil) <- paste0(rep(c("sin", "cos"), K), rep(1:K, each = 2))
  return(hasil)
}

waktu_train <- seq_along(train_data)
waktu_test  <- length(train_data) + seq_along(test_data)

fourier_train_k1 <- buat_fourier(waktu_train, periode = 11, K = 1)
fourier_test_k1  <- buat_fourier(waktu_test,  periode = 11, K = 1)

fourier_train_k2 <- buat_fourier(waktu_train, periode = 11, K = 2)
fourier_test_k2  <- buat_fourier(waktu_test,  periode = 11, K = 2)
```

```{r}
model_fourier_k1 <- auto.arima(
  train_data, 
  xreg = fourier_train_k1, 
  seasonal = FALSE,     
  stepwise = FALSE, 
  approximation = FALSE
)
summary(model_fourier_k1)
```
```{r}

)
summary(model_fourier_k2)
```
```{r}

ramalan_fourier_k2 <- forecast::forecast(model_fourier_k2, h = length(test_data), xreg = fourier_test_k2)
```

```{r}

model_ets <- tryCatch({

}, error = function(e) {

})

```

# Perbandingan Data Training
```{r}
model6_asli <- Arima(train_data, 
                     order = c(2, 0, 1), 
                     seasonal = list(order = c(0, 1, 1), period = 11))

get_ic <- function(model, name) {
  if (inherits(model, "tbats")) {
    n <- length(model$y)           
    k <- length(coef(model))       
    AIC_val <- model$AIC            
    AICc_val <- AIC_val + (2 * k * (k + 1)) / (n - k - 1)
    logLik_val <- (2 * k - AIC_val) / 2   
    BIC_val  <- -2 * logLik_val + k * log(n)
  } else {
    AIC_val  <- model$aic
    AICc_val <- model$aicc
    BIC_val  <- model$bic
  }
  
  data.frame(Model = name, AIC = AIC_val, AICc = AICc_val, BIC = BIC_val)
}

tabel_train <- rbind(
  get_ic(model6_asli,       "SARIMA (Model 6 - Asli)"),
  get_ic(model_ets,         "ETS (Auto)"),
  get_ic(model_tbats,       "TBATS (s=11)"),
  get_ic(model_tbats_coba,  "TBATS (s=11 & 5.5)"),
  get_ic(model_fourier_k1,  "Fourier K=1"),
  get_ic(model_fourier_k2,  "Fourier K=2")
)

tabel_train <- tabel_train[order(tabel_train$AICc), ]
tabel_train[, 2:4] <- round(tabel_train[, 2:4], 2)
rownames(tabel_train) <- NULL

print(tabel_train)
```

```{r}
pred_A      <- as.numeric(ramalan_A$mean)
pred_B      <- as.numeric(ramalan_B$mean)
pred_f1     <- as.numeric(ramalan_fourier_k1$mean)
pred_f2     <- as.numeric(ramalan_fourier_k2$mean)

aktual_test <- as.numeric(test_data)
naive_err_seasonal <- mean(abs(diff(as.numeric(train_data), lag = 11)))

hitung_metrik <- function(prediksi, aktual, denom_mase) {
  err <- aktual - prediksi
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(err^2))
  mae  <- mean(abs(err))
  mase <- mae / denom_mase
  return(c(RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae, MASE = mase))
}

metrik_sn <- hitung_metrik(pred_snaive, aktual_test, naive_err_seasonal)
metrik_s  <- hitung_metrik(pred_sarima, aktual_test, naive_err_seasonal)
metrik_e  <- hitung_metrik(pred_ets,    aktual_test, naive_err_seasonal)
metrik_A  <- hitung_metrik(pred_A,      aktual_test, naive_err_seasonal)
metrik_B  <- hitung_metrik(pred_B,      aktual_test, naive_err_seasonal)
metrik_f1 <- hitung_metrik(pred_f1,     aktual_test, naive_err_seasonal)
metrik_f2 <- hitung_metrik(pred_f2,     aktual_test, naive_err_seasonal)

tabel_test <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Seasonal Naive (Baseline)", "SARIMA (Model 6)", "ETS (Auto)", 
            "TBATS (s=11)", "TBATS (s=11 & 5.5)", "Fourier K=1", "Fourier K=2"),
  RMSE  = round(c(metrik_sn["RMSE"], metrik_s["RMSE"], metrik_e["RMSE"], 
                  metrik_A["RMSE"], metrik_B["RMSE"], metrik_f1["RMSE"], metrik_f2["RMSE"]), 2),
  MAE   = round(c(metrik_sn["MAE"], metrik_s["MAE"], metrik_e["MAE"], 
                  metrik_A["MAE"], metrik_B["MAE"], metrik_f1["MAE"], metrik_f2["MAE"]), 2),
  MASE  = round(c(metrik_sn["MASE"], metrik_s["MASE"], metrik_e["MASE"], 
                  metrik_A["MASE"], metrik_B["MASE"], metrik_f1["MASE"], metrik_f2["MASE"]), 4)
)

tabel_test <- tabel_test[order(tabel_test$MASE), ]
rownames(tabel_test) <- NULL

print(tabel_test)
```


# Perbandingan Diagnostik dan Signifikansi
```{r}
ekstrak_diagnostik_tahunan <- function(model, name) {
  if (inherits(model, "tbats")) {
    total_par <- length(model$lambda) + length(model$alpha) + length(model$beta) + 
                 length(model$damping.parameter) + length(model$gamma.one.values) + 
                 length(model$gamma.two.values) + length(model$ar.coefficients) + 
                 length(model$ma.coefficients) + 2 * sum(model$k.vector)
  } else {
    total_par <- length(coef(model))
  }
  
  sig_par <- NA 
  if (inherits(model, "Arima")) {
    p_vals <- lmtest::coeftest(model)[, 4]
    sig_par <- sum(p_vals < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  sisaan <- residuals(model)
  
  lb_p <- Box.test(sisaan, lag = 22, type = "Ljung-Box")$p.value
  shapiro_p <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(sisaan)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  arch_p <- Box.test((sisaan)^2, lag = 22, type = "Ljung-Box")$p.value
  ttest_p <- tryCatch(t.test(sisaan, mu = 0)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  
  data.frame(
    Model = name,
    Total_Par = total_par,
    Signifikan = sig_par,
    LB = lb_p,
    Shapiro = shapiro_p,
    ARCH = arch_p,
    T_Test = ttest_p
  )
}

tabel_diag_tahunan <- rbind(
  ekstrak_diagnostik_tahunan(model6,           "SARIMA (Model 6 - Log)"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_tahunan(model_tbats,      "TBATS (s=11)"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_tahunan(model_tbats_coba, "TBATS (11 & 5.5)"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_tahunan(model_ets,        "ETS (Auto)"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_tahunan(model_fourier_k1, "Fourier K=1"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_tahunan(model_fourier_k2, "Fourier K=2")
)

cols_to_round <- c("LB", "Shapiro", "ARCH", "T_Test")
tabel_diag_tahunan[cols_to_round] <- round(tabel_diag_tahunan[cols_to_round], 3)

print(tabel_diag_tahunan)
```
ETS melanggar asumsi galat saling bebas. SARIMA melanggar asumsi galat menyebar normal. TBATS (s=11) melanggar asumsi galat saling bebas. TBATS (s=11 & 5.5) melanggar asumsi galat saling bebas di dua kali siklus 5.5. Fourier K=2 memenuhi semua asumsi galat.
